name: Agile Robots
funFact: Agile Robots was spun out of the German Aerospace Center's Institute of Robotics and Mechatronics, and in 2023 it bought insolvent robot maker Franka Emika.

sources.quote: Agile Robots was founded in Munich in 2018 by researchers from the German Aerospace Center
The company was founded in 2018, with its headquarters both in Munich, Germany and Beijing, China.
Founded in 2018 by Peter Meusel and Zhaopeng Chen
Agile Robots SE is a German robotics and artificial intelligence company based in Munich , Germany.
Agile Robots SE is a German robotics and artificial intelligence company
In November 2023 Agile Robots acquired the Munich-based robotics company Franka Emika, which had filed for insolvency earlier that year.
announces the completion of a Series C financing with a total investment of US$220 million
In September 2021 the company raised $220 million in venture capital in a Series C funding round led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2.

The financing round is led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2*, followed by financial investors including but not limited to Chimera Investments under Abu Dhabi Royal Group, GL Ventures, Sequoia China and Linear Capital
announces the completion of a Series C financing
announced that it has raised $30M (approximately €27.94M) in funding from China’s Foxconn Industrial Internet (FII).
SoftBank-backed robotics unicorn Agile Robots receives €27.9M funding from Foxconn Industrial Internet
This is FII’s second strategic investment in Agile Robots.
